protocol.scope: Placement Python versus Go; original Glance remains control
protocol.status: prepared; requires pilot, explicit runner support and frozen manifest before measurement
protocol.purpose: Etapa 3 preliminary validation with reduced duration and declared coverage
protocol.log_policy: Bound VM operational logs; rotate only outside measured windows, retain recent incident diagnostics and all benchmark samples
protocol.statistics: Three independent paired repetitions; publish individual results, median and range, declare limited uncertainty; no claim of precise tail or statistical significance
protocol.supersedes_for_next_run: placement-v1; preserve all earlier attempts without mixing their samples
